stages.name: Foundation
stages.window: Now to Dec 2026 (NTI Linux block; DEBI start)
stages.gate: Gate 1: doc 06 F1 exit checks for NET and LNX pass unaided (URL walkthrough, 5 subnets in ~10 min, 3 broken-connectivity labs, fresh-VM Linux check).

stages.name: Cloud and DevOps Engineering
stages.window: Dec 2026 to mid-Feb 2027 (NTI Docker, CI/CD, AWS, Terraform, K8s, monitoring)
stages.gate: Gate 2: project stages PS-1 to PS-5 committed and SAA-C03 passed.

stages.name: Security Engineering
stages.window: Mid-Feb to about Jun 2027 (DEBI becomes the main structure)
stages.gate: Gate 3: IR runbook + tabletop postmortem written; OWASP self-review of the grad project with 3+ real fixes; SEC exit check (30 questions at 80%+).

stages.name: Cloud Security Specialization
stages.gate: Gate 4: PS-7 detects 5 simulated attacks with tested detections; SCS-C03 booked.

stages.name: Portfolio and Job Readiness
stages.window: Runs throughout; shown last because it collects the evidence
stages.gate: Gate 5: both CV versions live; every finished project stage has a portfolio README; a full mock interview passed.

paths.name: DevSecOps Engineer
paths.entry: Enter as junior DevOps/cloud engineer (or backend); DevSecOps title in 1–2 years (doc 19 G8).
paths.why: Only path both programs feed directly; uses your backend skills; same skills cloud security hires on.

paths.name: Cloud Security Engineer
paths.entry: Destination after DevSecOps experience; almost no junior titles in Egypt (doc 19 §B).
paths.why: Long-term target; Stage 4 is built for it.

paths.name: Cloud Security Operations / Detection
paths.entry: Usually via SOC L1, the most common entry-level security opening (shift work).
paths.why: Fallback only (G8); fits DEBI best, uses backend least.

paths.name: Application Security Engineer
paths.entry: Later specialty; needs code-review or pentest experience.
paths.why: Fits your backend background, but neither program teaches it deeply.

paths.name: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
paths.why: Safest door if getting hired fast matters most; risk of drifting from security.
